corrections.name: architecture
corrections.prompt: Image 1 is the newly styled architecture figure; image 2 is the accurate original diagram for scientific reference; image 3 is only a color/rendering style reference. Make ONE targeted correction in image 1 while preserving all panels, text, math and colors: in panel a, CPU worker, remove the 'space' axis label and replace the slice illustration with a two-dimensional time×feature sequence matrix. This project uses per-location tabular time sequences, not a spatial image dataset. Keep axis labels 'features' and 'time' only. Do not introduce any spatial dimension or new numbers. Keep other labels and equations exactly as they are; no logos or branding. Keep white scientific canvas and the rich pastel panel style.

corrections.name: locality
corrections.prompt: Make a single targeted text correction in image 1, keeping EVERY chart line, scale, cache sequence, table, formula, color and layout unchanged. Image 2 is the accurate original diagram. In panel c's introductory strip, replace 'Raw tensor payload per worker as a function of worker count W, for different prefetch depths P. Payload is computed as M=WPBS and reported in MiB.' with 'Total queued tensor payload across W workers, for prefetch depth P. M=WPBS is reported in MiB.' M is the total queued raw tensor payload across workers, not a per-worker amount. Preserve P=1,2,4; B=32;S=4824 bytes; line endpoints approx2.36,4.71,9.42MiB at W16, axis ticks1,4,8,12,16 and y0..10, and the analytical estimate label. Do not add logos or brand names.

corrections.name: sequence
corrections.prompt: Make two targeted label corrections in image 1, preserving its exact pastel research-diagram style, all six lifeline messages, arrows, colors and the CPU/GPU batch timing schematic. Image 2 is the accurate original. First replace the inaccurate code snippet in the upper-left Model training step box with these FOUR plain-language steps, not code: 'Request batch', 'Transfer tensors to device', 'Forward, loss, backward', 'Optimizer update'. corrections.name: feedback
corrections.prompt: Make targeted shape-label corrections in image 1, preserving the exact rich scientific-panel composition and all learning routes, rewards, panels, connectors and colors. Image 2 is the original scientific diagram. The feature history has FOUR channels, and wind predictions/targets have TWO channels. Replace all history input shape labels (B,45,d) with (B,45,4); label these X_enc rather than giving S a tensor shape, since S is the full conditioning tuple. Replace ALL prediction and target shape labels (B,27,d) with (B,27,2), in both the supervised and RL rows. Replace any duplicated single d notation accordingly. Keep blue/rose Yhat/Y matrices, sampled forecast notation, MSE/REINFORCE distinction and stochastic sampling graphic. Future time marks condition the model, while recorded future wind values are only targets/reward feedback. No added performance curves, metrics, logos, CUDA/NVIDIA wording or decorative title.
